quote: In this paper, we aim to build a dataset for hierarchical table QA and NLG.

We place HiTab as a middle-ground of ToTTo and LogicNLG to make the task more controllable... given a hierarchical table T , highlighted cells C, and specified operators O, the goal is to generate a faithful description S. ... We conduct experiments by fine-tuning four state-of-the-art text generation methods on HiTab.
